body: Headless TUI testing: fzf writes ESC[6n and Codex writes OSC 10;? / OSC 11;? and wait for replies a runbay PTY never sends; answer them with `runbay session input <id> "$(printf '\033[1;1R')"` or nothing renders. Exit Claude Code with /exit: two ctrl-c did not exit and the next typed line became a prompt. Prefer --dry-run + process inspection (ps, lsof -d cwd). For fzf pickers (agx ws, resume -b, sessions move -i) the fastest check is a fake `fzf` script first on PATH that logs the prompt, flags (--multi) and rows and prints the pick, combined with --dry-run (used for v0.3.1, 2026-10-14). Codex resume was verified at process level only, never on screen.
